scope: Only Aqua engines were measured. Historical official-baseline results were not rerun. T2S and latency use separate v3 checkpoint workloads. Latency uses the earlier README v3 checkpoint pair/reference; audio equivalence uses the current production v3 checkpoint pair. No model/reference material or runtime logs are included.

audio_equivalence.sequence: 3 seeds per device; each seed set once before 4 consecutive synthetic Japanese/English utterances per dynamic/static/graph path

t2s_protocol.eos: Native EOS predicate is executed and its stopping result ignored; EOS ID unchanged.
t2s_protocol.timing: Selected CUDA device synchronized immediately before and after each call; one GPU benchmark process at a time.

paired_protocol: Same model, graphs, sampler, seeds and process; alternating A/B then B/A order; native EOS tensor/host computation retained, stopping ignored for fixed work; 15 paired conversation warmups; 20 measured pairs per README shape.

latency_protocol.definition: Warm model-side first PCM including generated silence; the packet definition matches the historical untrimmed tables. First spoken sound is a separate metric. Measured calls use no synchronized stage timing; first use, warmup and diagnostics are separate.

latency_trimmed_protocol.definition: Supplemental current-production first-PCM packet timing after leading-silence buffering/trimming; same model/text/seed settings as the untrimmed retest.
